headings.usage: Main page titles, hero text, section headers. Gives the heraldic, classic luxury feel requested by the crest logo.

subheadings.usage: Overlines, labels, button text, and small accent text. Provides the bold, condensed, masculine aesthetic.

body.usage: Paragraphs, descriptions, form inputs. Ensures clean readability in data-heavy areas like the admin dashboard.

visual_enhancers.background_texture: The entire app must have a subtle dark textured paper background to match the 'Padrão RD' identity. Add an absolute/fixed inset div with `bg-[url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1578662996442-48f60103fc96?crop=entropy&cs=srgb&fm=jpg&ixid=M3w4NjA1NzB8MHwxfHNlYXJjaHwxfHxkYXJrJTIwcGFwZXIlMjB0ZXh0dXJlJTIwYmFja2dyb3VuZHxlbnwwfHx8fDE3ODg2NDA5OTV8MA&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&q=85')] bg-cover bg-center opacity-10 mix-blend-overlay pointer-events-none z-0` over a solid `#050505` background.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use sharp corners (`rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`) to maintain the masculine, structured look. Borders should be 1px solid using the `border.default` color (faint gold).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Avoid soft, diffuse shadows. Use sharp, offset drop shadows for a premium layered feel, or zero shadows relying on border contrast.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Do not use vibrant gradients. If gradients are needed for overlays, use deep black to transparent (`bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] to-transparent`).

layouts.hero_section: Dark, moody interior background image (heavily overlaid with black/60 so it's barely visible). Massive 'Cormorant Garamond' headline centered or left-aligned. Minimalistic.
layouts.barber_profiles: Tall vertical cards. Top 60% is a greyscale or high-contrast photo of the barber. Bottom 40% has a solid dark background with the barber's name in Gold Serif, specialties in Silver Condensed Sans, and availability. Use 1px gold borders.
layouts.booking_flow: Step-by-step wizard. Stepper component should use gold lines connecting numbers. Steps: Service -> Barber -> Date -> Time Slot -> Payment (Stripe). Keep spacing generous (`gap-8` to `gap-12`).
layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density grid layout for managing services, barbers, and appointments. Sharp edges, dark surfaces (`#121212`), high contrast text. Use Shadcn tables with gold active states.

components.button: Primary: Solid Gold (`bg-[#D4AF37]`) with Black text (`text-[#050505]`), sharp corners (`rounded-sm`), uppercase condensed font (`font-oswald tracking-widest`). Hover: Darker gold (`hover:bg-[#AA8222]`). Secondary: Outline with Gold border and text, transparent background.
components.time_slot_chip: Rectangular buttons for time selection. Default: `border border-[#D4AF37]/30 text-[#A0A0A0] bg-transparent`. Hover: `border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37]`. Selected: `bg-[#D4AF37] text-black border-[#D4AF37]`. Disabled: `opacity-50 line-through pointer-events-none`.
components.inputs: Forms (login, profile edit) should use dark inputs with a bottom border only (material style) or fully outlined with `border-[#D4AF37]/30`. Background `#121212`. Focus state should highlight the border to solid Gold (`#D4AF37`).

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Luxury Barbershop Booking platform (SaaS) called Padrão RD. Do NOT use the default Shadcn Inter font or light mode.
Force Dark Mode globally. Update tailwind.config.js to define the custom fonts (Cormorant Garamond, Oswald, Manrope) and custom colors (Deep Black, Metallic Gold).
Integrate a global background layout wrapper that applies the dark paper texture image (`image_urls.texture_paper`) with `opacity-10 mix-blend-overlay` over a `#050505` base background.
Implement the 3 admin profiles (Admin dashboard) as a separate route (`/admin`) for managing barbers, services, and viewing appointments.
Implement the Client flow: Landing Page -> Login/Signup -> Booking Wizard -> Client Dashboard (view/cancel appointments).
Booking flow must be sequential: 1. Service -> 2. Barber -> 3. Date (Calendar) -> 4. Time Slot (Chips) -> 5. Payment (Stripe Mock).
Barber cards must display photo, name, specialties, and a rating.
Ensure all interactive components have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="book-appointment-button"`).
Use standard HTML+Tailwind for the landing page hero and marketing sections, and Shadcn UI components for the booking forms and dashboards (customized to match the gold/black theme).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and absolute positioning for background elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects. Static = dead.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. Example: `data-testid="service-select-button"`
